summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The Cohen & Steers Real Assets Active ETF (CSRA) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in target outcome asset allocation. The fund is actively managed, seeking attractive long-term total returns and maximum real returns through exposure to US and non-US real assets. This includes equities, commodities, and fixed income securities. CSRA was launched on Aug 11, 2026 and is issued by Cohen & Steers.
